mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (payment_no, order_id, user_id, amount, pay_type, status, pay_method) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{payType}, #{status}, #{payMethod})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payment WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND DATE(pay_time) = CURRENT_DATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payment WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT id, payment_no, order_id, user_id, amount, pay_type, status, pay_method, pay_time, create_time, update_time FROM payment ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
